source.origin: project-authored program ivs-demo-lamp-tone-1, Lamp Tone, source lamp-tone.asm (plan 07-06, D-01 to D-07, D-28)

note: project-authored program, the first redistributable original program; built images live only in the build tree and are never committed. Third-party attestation (D-28, D-36): the program contains no third-party glyph, font, tune, jingle or picture, no EXEC call and no graphics ROM read, no data table and no text; the one graphics card is a solid block of eight bytes FF and the colours are the numbers 1 and 2 (project-authored, not art); the tone of a port is the controller byte itself, so there is no melody or scale; the layout of the lamp rows is the derivation's own. Order of the evidence (D-23): the specification and every expected value were derived by hand in docs/video/demo-lamp-tone-1-derivation.md (oracle commit 4e0febef675c2e81fe38d6c0caf353625218b1eb) and read blind by an isolated reader (docs/video/demo-lamp-tone-1-second-read-record.md, commit 1621dae, zero corrections) before this source was written; lamp-tone.asm is the source of truth and is written from sections (a) to (d) of that derivation only, and lamp-tone.listing.txt is generated from it by ivs_asm (the project mini-assembler) and committed unedited; a suite test regenerates it and requires byte equality. Nothing is copied or adapted from another implementation, assembler, test program or title. tools/pack builds the one-segment IVSC v1 image from the listing into build/<preset>/images/lamp-tone.ivsc. It runs through the project boot stub contract 2 (boot-stub-2) with the zero graphics ROM; no measured-hardware claim and no owner EXEC or GROM image. recipe.sources and tool_sha256 are verified by the manifests step: any edit of the source, of tools/asm/asm.c or of tools/pack/pack.c refreshes the recipe digests, and any edit of the listing or the source refreshes the outputs entries (cmake -E sha256sum and size), in the same commit.
